Messages.Author: Lupus Australis
Messages.Body:
A minion is blocked and chooses a strike. His opponent also chooses a
strike (say, Earth Meld at Superior). Can the acting minion tap the
Elesium (Arboretum) to end combat before the opposing strike resolves (so
that, in the case of Earth Meld, the opposing vampire remains tapped)?

Messages.Author: Dhar...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:
Lupus Australis <jbwh...@dorsai.org> wrote:
> A minion is blocked and chooses a strike. His opponent also chooses a
> strike (say, Earth Meld at Superior). Can the acting minion tap the
> Elesium (Arboretum) to end combat before the opposing strike resolves (so
> that, in the case of Earth Meld, the opposing vampire remains tapped)?

Nope. By card text, the Arboretum must be used before maneuvers are
declared. For example, if my Ventrue has an Assault Rifle that he wants
to use, and the opposing vampire plays a DotB, I can tap the Arboretum
in response, but if I have a !Malk that wants to play Coma, but the
opposing vampire plays IG, it's too late to tap the Arboretum.

Noal
